title: Metallic Bonding and Material Properties
requiredLabVisualSimulationEvidence: Structure-property evidence analysis using a metallic bonding model and property table. No heating or lab materials are required.
simulationVirtualLabReviewRequirement: Required for bonding models, molecular geometry, ionic/covalent comparisons, and intermolecular forces
directSimulationStudentTask: After the simulation opens, use the model-building screen with a central atom. Add bonded atoms one at a time, then add lone pairs if the lesson model calls for them. Observe how each added electron domain changes the three-dimensional shape. Record the number of bonded atoms, number of lone pairs, shape name or visual description, and how the model supports Metallic Bonding and Material Properties.
simulationReviewImplementation: Student-facing lesson includes one exact direct simulation/resource link plus adjacent step-by-step directions for what to open, click/use, observe, record, and connect to the lesson standard.
